title: Design for New Milford High School Tennis Courts
short_description: Design and reconstruction of six high school tennis courts in post-tensioned concrete.
project_scope: Demolition of six existing asphalt tennis courts and reconstruction of the facility using high-performance post-tensioned concrete at New Milford High School.
services: Professional design, engineering, and construction administration services; requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, programming, civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, soil testing, surveying/GIS/mapping, construction/project management, inspection services, and stormwater.
relevance_explanation:
- Sports-related project, but limited to tennis courts rather than a stadium or long-span sports structure.
- Scope focuses on court reconstruction and site-related disciplines, not complex structural engineering.
- Post-tensioned concrete adds some technical interest, but overall structural complexity is low.
- Includes design and engineering services, yet the project is primarily civil/site work and not a typical sbp core project.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender notice. Available scope information: demolition of 6 existing asphalt tennis courts and reconstruction in high-performance post-tensioned concrete, with associated stormwater and site-related services. A realistic cost estimate is not possible from the notice alone without court dimensions, drainage scope, lighting/fencing details, and site conditions.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the tender notice. The procurement seeks a single fixed-price proposal for design, engineering, and construction administration services, but the notice provides no budget, fee basis, or service phase breakdown.
references_qualifications: Qualified firms are requested to provide professional design, engineering, and construction administration services. Specific reference counts or detailed qualification thresholds are not stated in the notice.
award_criteria: Single fixed-price proposal requested; detailed award criteria and weighting are not stated in the notice.
